title: Thunderstorm Notifier
description: Receive instant Discord notifications via Webhooks whenever a thunderstorm starts in Minecraft.
body:
# **⚡️ Thunder Alert**
## Never miss a lightning bolt again!

This lightweight mod uses Discord Webhooks to send you a direct notification whenever a thunderstorm starts in your world. Perfect for players who go AFK while waiting for thunderstorms to charge creepers, hunt for mob heads, or gather rare resources.

## **✨ Features**

- Discord Integration: Uses standard Webhooks for easy setup.
  
- AFK Optimized: Get pinged on your phone or desktop while you're away from the screen.
  
- Simple Configuration: Just paste your Webhook URL and you're ready to go.
  
- Lightweight: Minimal impact on game performance.
  
- Turn On/Off in settings from [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)

## **🛠️ How it works**

- Create a Webhook in your Discord Server settings.
  
- Paste the URL into the mod's config file.
  
- Go AFK and relax! The mod will handle the rest.

[![Detailed Instructions](https://img.shields.io/badge/Detailed-Instructions-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=read-the-docs)](https://github.com/JordiBurguera/thunder-notifier-mod/blob/main/README.md#📂-3-installation--configuration)

## **📝 Requirements**

- Loader: Fabric
  
- Version: 26.2
  
- Side: Client-side

- Extras: [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) (for Enable/Disable feature you will need [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config))
